 SSC CPO City Intimation Slip 2026 OUT: Check SI Exam City Details at ssc.gov.in - Direct Link Here
 By Bebo Rani Last Updated: Nov 13, 2026, 19:25 IST SSC CPO City Slip 2026: SSC has released the Exam City Intimation Slip 2026 on November 13, 2026, on its official website, ssc.gov.in. Candidates can now check and download their exam city details from the direct link given in this article.
 SSC CPO City Intimation Slip 2026 OUT: Check SI Exam City Details at ssc.gov.in - Direct Link Here Key Points
 SSC CPO City Intimation Slip 2026 released on November 13, 2026, for Paper-I.
 Paper-I of the SSC CPO 2026 exam is scheduled from November 23 to 28, 2026.
 Approx. 21,000 candidates must upload matriculation docs by November 20, 2026.
 SSC CPO City Intimation Slip 2026 OUT: The SSC has released the SSC CPO City Intimation Slip 2026 on November 13, 2026 , for the Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police and Central Armed Police Forces (CPO) Examination 2026, Paper-I. Candidates who have applied for this recruitment can now check their exam city details on the official website, ssc.gov.in, by logging in to their account. The Paper-I exam will be held from 23rd to 28th November 2026 . The admit card will be available for download about 2-3 days before each candidate's exam date. The Commission has also issued an important alert for about 21,000 candidates whose matriculation details show discrepancies. Check this article to know how to check your city slip and what these candidates must do. 
 SSC CPO City Intimation Slip 2026 Download PDF
 SSC CPO Exam City Slip 2026 is now available on the official website, ssc.gov.in. Candidates can view and download their city slip as a PDF from the direct link given below. Keep your registration number and password ready before you log in.

 Steps to Download SSC CPO City Slip 2026 
 Candidates can check their exam city and download the slip online in a few simple steps. Keep your registration number and password ready before you start. 
 Step 1: Visit the official website of the Commission, ssc.gov.in. 
 Step 2: Log in to the candidate portal with your registration number and password. 
 Step 3: Go to the City Live / Admit Card Status page for the SICPO 2026 examination. 
 Step 4: Your exam city details for Paper-I will appear on the screen. 
 Step 5: Download the city intimation slip as a PDF. 
 Step 6: Take a printout and keep it safe for future reference.
